reviews.x: Be very careful when using. The hooks are very thick and kind of tough to get on the rubber band without getting hair in between the blade and band. It sliced my daughters hair right off!!! They need to consider making the hook a lot thinner than it really is. I won’t say this is a bad product because it’s not. But just be very cautious when using.

reviews.t: How are these not more popular?!?! Amazing!
reviews.x: My little ones have been born with a lot of hair. So we use a lot of the little plastic elastics. My husband is great about helping bathe the kids but has silently suffered trying to get all the little elastics out without hurting the kids. I stumbled on these little cutters and thought: “Oh, he would love that!” I thought about using just a standard envelope opener since the design is so similar but these were cheap enough I just bought them.  When I showed my husband them and how to use them h

I wish I had invented these - so simple and so helpful! My toddler has thick, 3c hair and getting bands out of it on wash day can be a disaster. Luckily this little tool makes it easy, and she won't accidentally cut herself if she grabs it.

I love these picks for those little rubber elastics that are pain to remove! No more tears from my girls. You do have to use them properly and pull elastic away to cut the elastic and not hair. My daughter proactively used it before I could and sliced a good amount of hair lol it’s this little patch. So now they aren’t allowed to use it without me present but otherwise it works great. Just use it properly.

Long story short, it slices hair off. I thought the gap where the blade is would be much smaller than it is. It leaves too much space for hair to get trapped and also my child’s fingers fit in the exposed blade area. I won’t be using this again.
It comes in handy to cut the rubber band out of my hair so I don’t pull hair out. I am careful to cut only the band, not the hair.

reviews.t: Only for adults to use! But cool tool for cutting hair elastics.
reviews.x: This is such a cool gadget if only used by adults. My 8 year old likes to do her own hair sometimes and one day she used the small elastics. She knows I use this to remove the hair ties and decided to use it. It cut her hair and now she has two one inch patches that stick up on top of her head.

I love these! It has totally taken the whining out of getting ready for the bath. My toddler hated bath time because no matter how gentle I was, I would tug her hair to get hairbands out. This makes both of our lives easier!
Best thing I’ve bought lately! I do a lot of rubber band styles and always struggle to get the little rubber bands off, since I got this, no more struggle!
I discovered these after a blogger recommended them, and I’m so glad I did! These are great for cutting elastics, and prevent tears from pulling them out!
I wish I had found these sooner! I was always ripping my daugher’s hair out before bath time and I felt awful but these do the trick.
Wish I would have found these earlier! Another tictok find!

I never thought something so small and simple would be so useful! I use this daily to take off those clear elastic rubberbands from my 1 year old daughters hair. I keep one in my diaper bag, in the bathroom, and in my room. Those rubberbands are a pain to take off and my daughter didn't like when I had to take them off because it would sometimes get stuck in her hair. I use this tool and slide it up rather than down to prevent any hair getting caught. It's so quick and easy that it never bothers

Such a life changer easy to use cuts super clean and precisely if your daughter happens to get a hold of it chances of getting cut are very slim as the blade is in the middle so its a little safer slides right into the bands and cuts no problem I seriously am so glad I got one I tell everyone about them now lol Just be cautious as it can and will cut your hair if not careful but overall it is AMAZING get it!

I bought this to take the rubberbands out of my puppy's topknots.  Before when  I used to take them out, some of her hair used to come with the rubberband.  I tried this not sure if it would work well or not and I was TOTALLY AMAZED.  It works so well and I unwrap the rubberband with no strands of hair stuck with it.  It's a game changer - so worth buying - would definitely recommend!

The idea and use of these are GENIUS. My almost 2 year old HATEESSSS having her hair taken down, but these are quite thick and tough to actually use. I understand they couldn't be too thin as they'd easily break, but I feel like it could've been a bit smaller for the practicality of the use. Definitely worth it, just know that they're not a perfect design.

I'm so glad I know these exist! This is so much more comfortable for my daughter for removing the tight little hair ties. It's great there are 3 devices to stash at several locations and I also gave 1 to my parents to keep at their house. What a great product, exactly as expected, and saves my daughter from the pain of the manual removal of hair ties.

reviews.t: Best thing for my girls' hair!
reviews.x: I've been using these hair cutters for a little over a year now and just bought 3 more to place around my house since a few had gone missing. These are amazing! We use them every day and my daughter doesn't feel any pain or pulling compared to when I try to remove the elastic with my fingers. Definitely worth every penny.

100% the easiest way to remove the elastic  from my toddler’s hair! We were using the lemon essential oil method which worked well but would need to put a little on each rubber band or rub more onto my fingers for each elastic  removal! They are not a super strong plastic but for the price, I’d buy them again!

reviews.t: If you use elastics on a kid you NEED these.
reviews.x: I put my 10 month old daughters hair up in a “pony” atleast 3 times a week to keep her hair out of her face since it’s at an awkward length to do much else with it. She hates when I would take it out because it would pull. Works great to quickly snap an elastic before bath time. No more tears!

I used to fight with my daughter every night to remove her rubber bands but after purchasing these she will see it in my hand and come to me to have her hair taken down these are life changers and I must have if you have a toddler who fights you every girl mom needs this in their life.

I can see how this is a good tool. My girls were excited to remove their own elastics. I didn't realize this tool has a small blade which resulted in them slicing the ends of their hair right along with the elastics. Luckily they have lots of big luscious curls so it will go unnoticed.

It does it’s job and cuts the elastic but you still have to be careful not to get any hair with it or it cuts the hair too. I feel like either using this or pulling the elastic out you will still run the risk of ripping or cutting hair. I’ve decided a small pair of scissors works best.

Es bastante buena esta herramienta el único inconveniente es que el gancho es muy ancho y si la liga está muy muy apretada no se estira lo suficiente y esta herramienta no puede entrar y por lo mismo no corta la liga, pero si la liga está floja, si le permite entrar y cortar.

These are great for parents with Littles. These make removing hair ties much easier and less painful. I'd been using scissors for a while now and was always worried about accidently cutting my girls hair. These help eliminate that worry and speed the process along.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the tool effective for removing small rubber elastics without pulling or tearing hair, calling it a lifesaver or game changer.
Several reviewers report that the tool can cut hair if not used carefully, especially when the hook is too thick or the blade gap is too large.
Some reviewers emphasize that it should only be used by adults, as children using it themselves have cut their hair.
A few reviewers note the blade is positioned in the middle, making it relatively safe if a child grabs it.
Multiple reviewers wish they had found the product sooner and recommend it to others.
